latest.notes: Fixes the stalls triggered by connecting via remote desktop. A remote session (Jump Desktop) re-enumerates Core Audio, which can briefly make the configured program interface unresolvable or make the audio unit reject it. The engine re-applies the output device on every element start, and it used to log that failure and start ANYWAY on a dead device — producing splattered static and a frozen playhead. It now falls back to the system default so audio keeps playing, logs which device it landed on, and returns to the configured interface automatically as soon as it's available again. The Live365 stream taps the mixer rather than the physical device, so a fallback never affects the broadcast. Includes the v0.5.18 stream backpressure fix.
